Name: Cherry Blossom Cafe Recipes
Author: maerumaer2u
Description:
Some illegal sites are stealing my mods.
PLEASE DO NOT DOWNLOAD OTHER SITE!
I upload my mods only to https://kayainsdv.postype.com!  Nexus versions will NOT be updated!

Created by KAYA (https://kayainsdv.postype.com) and fwippy

Let's enjoy a cherry blossom cafe menu for SDV Discord's Spring 2020 Event!

Includes 1 new Artisan Good, 6 Drinks and 10 Cooking Recipes! All recipes can be purchased from Gus.
Cherry Blossom from Korea Blossom mod is needed for this mod to work. Make sure you have all other requirements before
installing.
Translation support → openkaya@gmail.com


<Artisan Good>
Cherry Blossom Syrup : Cherry Blossom + 2 sugar (from Syrup Maker)

<Drinks>
Cherry Blossom Soda : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Sparkling Water (from Artisanal Soda Maker)
Cherry Blossom Cream Soda : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Sparkling Water + Vanilla Extract (from Cream Soda Maker)
Cherry Blossom Jelly Soda : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Sparkling Water + Cherry Blossom Jelly
Cherry Blossom Latte : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Coffee + Sugar + Any Milk
Cherry Blossom Chocolate Latte : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Cocoa Pod + Sugar + Any Milk
Cherry Blossom Tea : Tea Leaves + Cherry Blossom

<Cooking Recipes>
Cherry Blossom Jelly : Cherry Blossom Syrup + White Algae + Sugar + Cherry Blossom
Cherry Blossom Ice Cream: Cherry Blossom + Sugar + Milk + Cherry
Cherry Blossom Meringue Cookie : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Any egg + Sugar
Cherry Blossom Macaron : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Almond + Sugar + Any Milk
Cherry Blossom Panna cotta : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Any Milk + Sugar + Vanilla + Pomegranate
Cherry Blossom Pudding : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Any egg + Sugar
Cherry Blossom Rice Cake : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Rice + Sugar
Cherry Blossom Roll Cake : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Wheat Flour + Sugar + Any egg + Any 2 Milk + Cherry Blossom Jelly
Cherry Blossom Cheese Cake : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Cheese + Any egg + Cranberry
Cherry Blossom Chiffon Cake : Cherry Blossom Syrup + Wheat Flour + Sugar + Any egg + Any Milk + Cherry
